Alongside peer-reviewed research, David writes for policy and practitioner audiences and contributes to applied briefs through the [Maryland Equity Project](https://education.umd.edu/research/centers/mep). This page collects that public-facing work; his [Research](research.qmd) page covers the peer-reviewed record.
